dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters present on the posterior half of the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between pigmented mottled regions and the primary light-grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of several faint, longitudinal linear marks of higher contrast on the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint longitudinal linear markings, likely superficial scars or rake marks, localized on the posterior dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular point contrast at the anterior dorsal position corresponding to the blowhole.
